senses.gloss: m. (Denom. of אושפיז = אושפיזך, with locat. ך, cmp. דָּא, דֵּךְ) innkeeper, landlord, host.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 26a:14">Meg. 26ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 12a:5">Yoma 12ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sotah 37a:2">Sot. 37ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 54a:1">Zeb. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>נעשה א׳ וכ׳</he> Benjamin became the host of the Divine Presence (the Temple being partly situated in his territory).
